assets.rename.title: Rename Asset
assets.rename.hint: New path (relative to Assets/; the .meta travels with it → scene references stay intact)
assets.tip.dbl_rml: Double-click: load into the game UI (shown during Play)
assets.tip.rcss: Referenced by documents via <link>; edits hot-reload
assets.table.summary_fmt: {0}: {1} rows × {2} cols (first row = column headers) · double-click a cell to edit, Enter to commit · changes take effect next Play
assets.table.playing_hint: Play in progress: this run keeps its table snapshot; changes apply next run
assets.audio.title: Audio Settings
assets.audio.loop_hint: Loop start and end both 0 = loop the whole clip; changes take effect on next Play
assets.audio.preload: Load fully into memory (large files stream by default)
assets.audio.retrigger: Limit retrigger interval (rapid repeats of the same sound read as one)
assets.audio.voice_cap: Limit simultaneous voices (how many copies of one sound may overlap; 1 = no overlap)
assets.audio.pitch_jitter: Slight random pitch variation (repeats sound less mechanical)
assets.audio.not_baked: Not baked yet (baked on demand at Play / preview)
assets.audio.tip_actions:
Double-click: preview / stop
Right-click: audio settings... (loop, loading mode, playback effects)
